newsitem.title: ITALY: Parmalat says no decision on Ault.
newsitem.headline: Parmalat says no decision on Ault.

text.p: Italy's largest listed food group Parmalat said on Wednesday that it had made no decision on a possible move for Canadian food group Ault Foods currently the target of a takeover bid.

A spokesman at Parmalat said there had been contracts with the Canadian group but no decision had been taken. Ault Foods has advised all its shareholders to delay making any decision on an offer for the group from an affiliate of Saputo Group Inc.

"Ault is the subject of a hostile bid and it has contacted possible white knights. We have been consulted along with other food groups. For now, we have only valued the operation," said the group spokesman.
